description: Defines the QuicDispatcher class, a server-side component responsible for dispatching client data to streams, managing sessions, handling packets, and connection lifecycle in a QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: QuicDispatcher
classes.description: A server-side dispatcher class managing QUIC sessions, packet processing, connection lifecycle, and related operations.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Handles incoming packets, creating sessions or passing packets to existing sessions or time-wait list.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Sends connection close frames to all clients and shuts down the dispatcher.

methods.name: CreateQuicSession
methods.description: Abstract method to create a new QUIC session based on connection info.

methods.name: MaybeDispatchPacket
methods.description: Validates and attempts to dispatch a packet; returns true if handled.

methods.name: ValidityChecks
methods.description: Performs validity checks on incoming packets to determine their fate.

methods.name: ProcessChlo
methods.description: Processes a full client hello, creating a new connection and delivering buffered packets.

methods.name: SelectAlpn
methods.description: Selects the preferred ALPN from a list based on supported protocols.
